name: Can I sell my pre-construction condo before it's completed? (Assignment)

mainEntity.name: Can I sell my pre-construction condo before it's completed? (Assignment)

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, selling a pre-construction condo before completion, known as an assignment, is often possible, but it depends heavily on the developer's policies. Many developers allow assignments, sometimes with a fee or specific restrictions, while others may prohibit it entirely until a certain stage of construction or even after closing. This presents a practical tradeoff: an assignment can allow you to realize profits without finalizing the purchase, but it also means navigating developer-specific rules and potentially facing additional costs. Reviewing the assignment clause in the purchase agreement is a critical step.
acceptedAnswer.description: Selling a pre-construction condo before completion (assignment) is often possible, but depends on developer policies and may incur fees or restrictions. Understanding these terms is crucial before proceeding.
